For those of you who enjoy Australian horror movies, then you might want to jump on this. Although I am not a horror movie lover, I had to jump on this as there was a shortage of action movies. This movie felt more like a thriller movie than horror, it wasn’t that scary. In this movie, a terrifying Pandemic struck their area. There was a father who had to run all through the desert to save his daughter’s life. In trying to save his wife, he got bitten and also had to try to protect his daughter, while trying not to contaminate her. You will need to watch the entire movie to see how he fought to save his daughter’s life, how he had to work with a young boy to save all their lives. The 104m Australian horror movie was directed by Yolanda Ranke, Ben Howling, they featured actors like Martin Freeman, Anthony Haryes, Susie Porter, Kris McQuade, Caren Pistorius etc.
Honestly, I really haven’t seen any clumsier movie than this in a very long while, the movie was just everywhere and left me even more confused than when I started. I really struggled with it, in this movie, a group of old friends left their kids behind in a resort to go attend a beautiful birthday bash at a fantastic beautiful luxury lodge. This lodge had everything in it, a sauna, pool, and enough space to play around. On arrival at the lodge just as the party was getting started a bad storm struck that left them trapped in doors all through. Just as the birthday party was happening the birthday bash turns into a party of chaos, betrayals, grudges, fights and unnecessary battles. The 101m Swedish drama, comedies movie was directed by Josephine Bornebush, they featured actors like Christopher Wagelin, Grustaf Skarsgard, Allttte Opneim, Fillip Berg, Josephine Bornebush, Jonah Rhebong, Jonas Karlsson, Sam Shirpey, Gizem Erdogan.
If you enjoy movies that talk about underwater creatures, then you might want to jump on this movie. Tora was an old lady, who cleaned classes of an aquarium and along the line started to build a bond with them. Along the line they employed a new guy called Cameron who also started to build a bond with the creatures as he cleaned, tora and Cameron became good friends and built a relationship. You will need to go watch this movie to see if Cameron was able to convince Tora to remain in the city. The 103m drama, film based on books, was directed by Olivia Newman, they featured actors like Sally Field, Lewis Pullman, Alfred Molina, Colon Meaney, Joan Chen, Kathy Baker, Beth Grant, Donald Sales, Mapuana Makia and many more.
